label: Shure MXN-AMP (Networked Dante Low Imp/70V Poe+ Amp)

_avail.variant: Networked Dante Low Imp/70V Poe+ Amp
_avail.note: Also runs on PoE class 0 (12.95 W max). Dimensions published as 202 x 178 x 40 mm (L x W x H). Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked).

portsSource.note: MXN-AMP user guide pp.8-12 (About, Parts, Block pin assignments, Specifications)

ports.label: Line In (3.5 mm)
ports.notes: 3.5 mm TRS stereo line input (2 analog line-level channels)

ports.label: Speaker Out 1
ports.notes: LoZ, 2-pin block 5.08 mm (Dinkle 2ESDV-02P); 3.625 W (4-channel) or 7.25 W (2-channel); not usable together with 70V Out

ports.label: Speaker Out 2
ports.notes: LoZ, 2-pin block 5.08 mm (Dinkle 2ESDV-02P); 3.625 W (4-channel) or 7.25 W (2-channel); not usable together with 70V Out

ports.label: Speaker Out 3
ports.notes: LoZ, 2-pin block 5.08 mm (Dinkle 2ESDV-02P); 3.625 W (4-channel) or 7.25 W (2-channel); not usable together with 70V Out

ports.label: Speaker Out 4
ports.notes: LoZ, 2-pin block 5.08 mm (Dinkle 2ESDV-02P); 3.625 W (4-channel) or 7.25 W (2-channel); not usable together with 70V Out

ports.label: 70V Out
ports.notes: 70 V line, 2-pin block 7.5 mm (Dinkle 7ESDV-02P); 14.5 W; LoZ mode is default, 70V mode set in software

ports.label: Dante (PoE+)
ports.notes: Dante 4 in / 4 out and control; the only power input, PoE+ class 4 (25.5 W max) or PoE class 0 (12.95 W max)

ports.label: Logic In
ports.notes: Logic input only. 3-pin block 5.08 mm (Dinkle 2ESDV-03P): logic in, not connected, logic ground; switches between device presets 1 and 2
